ML Engineer — Delta Analytics

We're hiring an ML Engineer to join our data science team. Ideal candidates have
strong Python skills, experience with Scikit-learn or XGBoost, familiarity with
model deployment (Docker, FastAPI), and a good understanding of SQL. Experience
with deep learning frameworks like PyTorch is a plus if you have it, though not
required for this role. Prior experience in fintech or e-commerce analytics would
also be helpful. You should be comfortable working with imbalanced datasets and
explaining model decisions to non-technical stakeholders.
